issues.description: The Bitmap24 class member 'width' has different types in the template and the solution repositories: the template declares 'short width;' while the solution declares 'int width;'. This cross-repository attribute type inconsistency can confuse students (which type should they use) and may lead to subtle bugs or surprising behavior when comparing their implementation to the provided solution or when reading solution code as reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the member type consistent across template and solution. Prefer using 'int width;' in the template (matching the solution) or change the solution to 'short width;' if intentionally required. Update the header in the template repository to declare 'int width;' so both repositories use the same type and avoid student confusion.
